# Omani crowd clothing
Two original dishdasha garments, kumma embroidery, mussar folds and furakha details fitted to the existing MIT Rocketbox Talker and Phone rigs. Base skin, faces and animation derive from PeopleModels/Animated; retain the parent pack's Microsoft MIT licence and sources.json. The new garment meshes and procedural textile textures are project-authored, released under the same MIT licence.

References (visual/cultural guidance only; no downloaded photographs used as textures):
- https://www.omanconsulate.com/en/tourism-in-oman.html
- https://experienceoman.om/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Marhaba-Oman_compressed.pdf

Generated by ../Source~/dress_omani.py in Blender 5.2. Existing five-person crowd count and behaviours retained. Clothing is bone-skinned; no cloth simulation, new lights or physics bodies.
